Overview

Arica is a city in AP with a population of 230,000. Chile’s northernmost city on the Pacific coast, known for its year-round warm climate and archaeological sites. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 12a growing zone supports Tropical — year-round growing, tropical crops. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year.
